_status: DRAFT, methodology PROPOSAL for VCRI to ratify (Cairn Viktor, 2026-10-16). NOT ratified. A handful of illustrative entries so the ingester-to-scorer path can be exercised; it is not a crosswalk of CIS v8.1. Every target below is an argument, not a ruling: VCRI's change log decides.

framework.note: the official CIS OSCAL catalog, fetched at run time (catalogs/index.json); clause ids are the safeguard numbers

entries.rationale: enterprise asset inventory is the inventory half of 'Asset inventory and software provenance/SBOM'
MFA required for externally exposed applications speaks to authentication strength
MFA for administrative access, same subcriterion
a documented vulnerability management process is the policy side of 'Vulnerability and patch management'
collecting audit logs is a precondition of security monitoring coverage; arguable, data-v1 6a is the other candidate
automated backups; technology-v1 5b (resilience, backup and DR) is the other candidate and has no evidence-map slot yet
a security awareness program; the observed counterpart is the training completion export
incident response process; technology-v1 6b has NO evidence-map slot, so this entry demonstrates the gap path (emitted unmapped, reported by score.py)
